statement: Two sessions searched the test tree for the name RUBRIC_CHANGELOG to find the tests that read it, ran the two it named, and pushed a reworded entry; CI then failed bare-npx-invocation-guard, which walks leaderboard/ for every .md file and read "bunx launches," as an unpinned bunx call. A test that walks a directory reads files no search for their name finds. Rules: to find the tests that read a file, also search for its directory and extension, or run every guard that scans the tree before pushing a prose change.
